sources.title: Sample count versus recording time
sources.details: Duration = N/fs. The checked clip has 4591/8000 = 0.573875 seconds. At 16000 Hz, 2×4591 = 9182 points preserve that duration: 9182/16000 = 0.573875. Interpolation computes new time-point values; renaming cannot alter encoded sample rate. One recording is one example, whereas its waveform measurements are time samples. Figure quarter-cycle amplitudes are 0.5 sin(2π phase): 0, +0.5, 0, −0.5, 0.
